name: Sparks, Extinguished in a Touch
description:
Sometimes, protecting others is not a goal, but a process. Also, Ursus's crossbowmen also privately believe that killing others is not a goal, but a process. 
<Static Roadblock> Can block the movement of Ursus Civilians and Talulah, the Fighter; Can be destroyed by your units.
<Ursus Civilian> Life Points will be deducted by 1 when killed by an enemy.
